source_review_summary: Source re-review rebuilt XML Tables 2-9 into target-specific activity/toxicity rows, corrected the Table 2 ATCC-value parse error, preserved the linked database ATCC BAA-2365 versus primary ATCC BAA-2356 conflict, bounded mechanism claims to source-supported design/phenotypic/inferred evidence, and closes rwk-complete-test-0001 as accepted_with_cautions rather than clean acceptance.

remaining_cautions.note: Database rows list Enterococcus faecalis ATCC BAA-2365; primary paper methods/Table 2 list ATCC BAA-2356 for the 5 µM A3 MIC/MBC row.
Local supplementary PDF provides A3 RP-HPLC/MS identity figures only; no additional activity/toxicity table was found or fabricated.
The paper discusses membrane-related HDP behavior and antibiotic synergy but does not provide a direct A3 membrane-disruption assay in local material.
